thread:
alex: quick idea — can we add a couple tiny flags to the deploy bot to make change-window rollouts less hand-holding?
priya: like what?
alex: two flags: --preview (generate a structured release-note + checklist) and --lock-reason (attach human reason that shows up in console and rollback annotations)
priya: ooh yes. --preview would be great for the on-call to skim before hitting enter. also include a suggested canary schedule.
deploy-bot: info: prototype preview implemented. sample output on /deploy --preview below. (bot: not live)
alex: paste sample pls
deploy-bot: ```
/deploy --preview --service inference-api --image-tag v2026-03-22-rc3 \
  --change-window "2026-03-22 02:00-03:00Z" \
  --lock-reason "migrating user-index; quick rollback only"

Preview:
- Release stub: inference-api v2026-03-22-rc3
- Owner: @alex
- Change window: 2026-03-22 02:00-03:00Z (UTC)
- Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> 100%
- Abort triggers: error-rate >1% || p95 latency >2x baseline || 30% user complaints
- Rollback plan: pin previous image v2026-03-21-stable, notify #incidents, run quick DB revert script if needed
- Suggested release note template attached
```
maria: can we also have it emit a markdown release_note stub? small script to drop into repo.
ishaan: here's a tiny helper that converts preview -> release_note.md: 
```bash
cat <<EOF > release_note.md
- Version: v2026-03-22-rc3
- Service: inference-api
- Owner: @alex
- Canary: 5% 10m -> 25% 15m -> 100%
- Rollback: pin v2026-03-21-stable, disable canary, revert DB migration if needed
- Notes: migrate user-index, low-risk path tested in staging
EOF
```
sam: should we add a --pin-on-failure flag so deploy bot will automatically pin previous version if abort happens?
priya: yes but gated. maybe auto-pin for quick fixes, but require manual approval for DB schema rollbacks. --pin-on-failure with a policy set in team config.
ken: also add a lint step for the generated release note — ensure owner + rollback steps present. less noise in #release-notes.
ops-jen: from ops perspective, attach the lock-reason to the change-window so SRE can triage fast. happy to review small UX for the console.
maria: we should make the preview output include a diff of infra changes (if any) — small opt-in flag --show-manifest-diff
ishaan: one more: include a compact machine-readable summary (json/yaml) so our release automation can post to downstream systems. e.g. preview.json with keys: owner, canary, abort_triggers, rollback_cmds.
alex: this feels like a low-effort high-impact change. volunteers to turn prototype into a tiny PR?
priya: i can take the preview -> markdown + linting bits. will open a draft tomorrow.
ken: i'll add a small CI job to fail if generated release notes miss rollback instructions.
sam: can we also add a short checklist template in the preview for QA to confirm after canary? (smoke requests, anomaly checks)
alex: yes — include as a 3-item checklist.
priya: nice. tagging @deploy-bot to keep this thread alive :deploy-bot: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: ack — I will expose --preview, --lock-reason, --pin-on-failure flags on the staging bot by EOD and post an example.
ops-jen: thumbs for process + docs update after PR.
alex: thanks all. merging to design doc after PR lands. :rocket:
